1. Parties

This mutual non-disclosure agreement is made between ExampleCorp Ltd, a company registered in England and Wales with its registered office at 14 Lantern Row, Wexford Green, and Meridian Fieldcraft, a company registered in England and Wales with its registered office at 8 Hollowfield Lane, Calderwick, each a party and together the parties.

2. Definitions

Confidential Information means any information disclosed by one party to the other, in any form, that is marked as confidential or that would reasonably be regarded as confidential given its nature and the circumstances of disclosure. Confidential Information includes, without limitation, technical data, product plans, pricing, customer lists, business strategies, financial projections, and any analyses, notes, or materials derived from such information.

3. Confidentiality obligations

Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information strictly confidential, shall use it solely for the purpose of evaluating a potential business relationship, and shall protect it with at least the same care it applies to its own confidential information, and in any event with no less than reasonable care. Neither party shall reverse engineer, decompile, or disassemble any materials embodying the other party's Confidential Information, except to the extent such restriction is prohibited by law.

4. Permitted disclosures

A party may disclose Confidential Information to its employees, professional advisers, and affiliates who need to know it for the permitted purpose and who are bound by obligations at least as protective as those in this agreement, and may disclose it where required by law, regulation, or a court of competent jurisdiction, provided it gives the other party prompt written notice where lawful. Each party remains responsible for any breach of this agreement by those to whom it discloses Confidential Information.

5. Term

This agreement takes effect on the date of the last signature and continues for two (2) years from that date, after which it expires. The confidentiality obligations in this agreement survive for three (3) years following the expiry of this agreement.

6. Return or destruction

On the other party's written request, each party shall promptly return or destroy all Confidential Information of that party in its possession or control and, if requested, certify the destruction in writing. A party may retain copies that it is required to keep by law or that are created under routine archival or backup policies, and any such retained copies remain subject to the confidentiality obligations in this agreement for as long as they are held.

7. Limitation of liability

Each party's liability is capped at twelve months of fees. Neither party is liable for any indirect or consequential loss, loss of profit, or loss of goodwill arising under or in connection with this agreement, except in the case of fraud or wilful misconduct.

8. Governing law

This agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales, and the courts of England and Wales have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising from it.

9. Notices

Notices under this agreement must be in writing and are effective when delivered to the registered office of the receiving party, marked for the attention of its legal counsel. A notice sent by first-class post is treated as delivered two business days after posting.

10. General

This agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties regarding its subject matter, supersedes all prior discussions, and may only be amended in writing signed by both parties. Neither party may assign this agreement without the other party's prior written consent. If any provision of this agreement is held unenforceable, the remainder continues in full force and effect. No failure or delay in exercising a right under this agreement operates as a waiver of that right.
